The AirDNA Enterprise API exposes short-term rental market analytics and individual property data for Airbnb and Vrbo. It is organized into Market Data, Property Valuations & Comps (STR listing data and Rentalizer), Rentalizer Lead Gen, and Smart Rates Data. All requests are authenticated with a Bearer token obtained from AirDNA sales.
